57/G.goal: Explain how the VR viewing pipeline transforms and filters a three-dimensional scene before rendering, and identify the operations that support VR resource optimization.
57/G.achieves: Gives the learner a computer-graphics foundation for understanding VR rendering resource requirements and for applying optimization techniques later in the course.

57/O1.goal: Explain how the VR viewing pipeline maps a three-dimensional scene to a two-dimensional display and where geometry is removed to reduce rendering workload.
57/O1.achieves: Lets the learner identify the graphics-pipeline stages that determine computational cost and possible VR resource optimization opportunities.
